risks.title: Impact of extraordinary events on attendance
risks.score_rationale: Top-ranked external risk, explicit mention of COVID-19 leading to full operational shutdown. Strong language on material impact and persistent threat. Category weighted as high risk due to direct exposure to global events.

risks.title: Sensitivity to economic conditions and discretionary spending
risks.score_rationale: Central risk, repeated in multiple sections with terms such as 'material impact'. Direct link to consumer spending, inflation, unemployment, and credit availability. Post-COVID context reinforces relevance. Macroeconomic category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Risks related to tax changes and fiscal pressures
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of budgetary pressures potentially leading to new taxes. Assertive language on 'material impact'. Recurring risk in the gaming sector. Regulatory category weighted medium to high.

risks.title: Increased competition in physical and online gaming
risks.score_rationale: Strong language on increased competition due to the expansion of legal gaming across multiple states. Major strategic risk citing impact on revenue streams. Competition category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on technology and product obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Risk related to rapid innovation and the need to remain competitive. Mention of ability to innovate amid competitors. Technology category moderately weighted but critical for the Wagering segment.

risks.title: Risks related to equity investments and partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Mention of loss of control, disagreements, and inability to exit investments. Serious language on material impact. Capital category moderately weighted but recurring in strategic initiatives.

risks.title: Shortage of qualified personnel and high turnover
risks.score_rationale: Clear language on recruitment difficulties, high costs, and operational impact. Reference to licensing requirements for key employees. Human resources category moderately weighted but critical for continuity.
